    stats={'c0 again':0,'c1 again':0,'c0 count>2':0,'c1 count>2':0,'n':0,'diag':0,'c0mincnt':9,'c1mincnt':9}
    for i in range(30):
        row=D[i]
        if 8 in row: continue
        stats['n']+=1
        c0,c1=row[0],row[1]
        rest=row[2:]
        if c0 in rest: stats['c0 again']+=1
        if c1 in rest: stats['c1 again']+=1
        cnt0=row.count(c0); cnt1=row.count(c1)
        stats['c0mincnt']=min(stats['c0mincnt'],cnt0); stats['c1mincnt']=min(stats['c1mincnt'],cnt1)
        if c0==c1: stats['diag']+=1
    print(name,stats)
for nm,dd in [("T",TT),("d1",D1),("d2",D2),("d3",D3),("d4",D4)]:

from collections import Counter
def rankstats(D,name):
    res=[]
    for i in range(30):
        row=D[i]
        if 8 in row: continue
        cnt=Counter(row)
        # rank colors by count desc, tie by first occurrence
        items=sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv:(-kv[1], row.index(kv[0])))
        order=[c for c,_ in items]
        r0=order.index(row[0]); r1=order.index(row[1])
        res.append((r0,r1))
    print(name, "max rank:", max(max(a) for a in res), "dist:", Counter(res).most_common(8))
for nm,dd in [("T",TT),("d1",D1),("d2",D2),("d3",D3),("d4",D4)]:
    rankstats(dd,nm)
